descriptions.data: Binaries signed by Microsoft can be used to run low-reputation arbitrary code. This technique is used by attackers to move laterally or execute malicious code while evading detection.
descriptions.label: default

descriptions.data: Collect artifacts and determine scope. Update antivirus signatures and run a full scan. Isolate the machine from the network.
descriptions.label: fix
